newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Country Road says performance patchy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Country Road says performance patchy.

text.p: Country Road Ltd, the retailer of upmarket casual clothing and homewares, said on Thursday that its performance remained patchy, particularly due to continuing subdued apparel trading conditions in Australasia.
The introduction of a new distribution system had affected delivery and sales in February and early March.

The company said it was in a sound position to achieve growth and profitability based on steps it had taken to improve its Australasian business and plans for international expansion with distributors in the United Kingdom, Europe and South Africa.
